text:
violet_cs: Quick flag 10 - OptiRetail showing a sharp drop in API calls and active seats (~71% over last 10 days). Their champion (Evan M) left; procurement pinged with a shortlist that includes RivalAI. Possible renewal risk.

drew_csm: thanks. when's renewal and do we have a seat/license commitment?

violet_cs: renewal in 26 days. Committed seats are 1,200 but active seat count fell to ~340. No billing disputes. CRM shows admin change but no response to outreach.

ash_eng: any telemetry issues? 5xx, 429 bursts, or latency regressions?

violet_cs: infra's fine. Drop is embed/batch jobs pausing. They moved a nightly embedding job off-platform last week per an internal ticket.

renewals-bot: Renewal-30d alert triggered for account optiretail. Assigned to @claire_rev and @drew_csm.

claire_rev: looping in renewals. If procurement is shortlisting RivalAI we should prepare a tight commercial play: 6-week pilot with usage credits + dedicated Optimize scan. Need current consumption vs committed tiers.

drew_csm: proposed playbook: 1) 48h personalized outreach + small credit, 2) tech healthcall w/ash, 3) ROI + pilot doc from claire. Any objections? :thinking_face:

violet_cs: +1. also ask for a short inventory: top-10 endpoints, last-30d seat churn, any scheduled cron jobs moved. will add to CRM.

ash_eng: I can run a quick usage delta and produce p50/p95 latency + token breakup. Will need sample payloads from their top flows; can you pull those, violet?

violet_cs: on it. Also spotted a procurement snippet asking for cost per 1k tokens and p95 latency 100ms. adding to the ask list.

claire_rev: i'll prep a conservative competitor-cost comparison and a 3-month pilot one-pager contingent on a minimum usage commitment. If they ask for a formal RFP response, escalate.

drew_csm: scheduling outreach for tomorrow afternoon. violet, you lead the contact. ash and claire, have materials ready by EOD Wed. I'll mark CRM and tag account as "at-risk - renewal window".

violet_cs: done. outreach scheduled and actions logged.

ash_eng: quick note 12: quantization + batching reduced cost ~28% in a recent similar customer. i'll prepare a short demo and config recommendations.

claire_rev: good data point. include an ROI slide showing net cost vs RivalAI at 50k/100k token bands.

drew_csm: update - Lina (new PM) replied, limited availability next week but open to a short call. procurement still collecting vendor info but open to a pilot if cost wins are real.

violet_cs: will post meeting notes after the call and tag any procurement RFP requests.

renewals-bot: Actions recorded: outreach scheduled, tech healthcall prep, ROI deck draft.

drew_csm: aim is to convert this into a constrained pilot vs full RFP. move fast. :pray:
